exemptions.reason: This verb IS the index regenerator; a flag suppressing its own work would name nothing.

Takes the INDEX lock, not a per-issue write lock, so it has no per-issue acquisition to bound. Under IM-242 ('the name follows the lock') a bound here would be a third concept, which nothing has asked for.
The catchup sweep takes only the store-wide commit lock, bounded by --commit-timeout.
The sweep commits pending store state and runs no index regeneration of its own.
Migration's index write is part of its two-commit contract (IM-054), not an optional post-step.

class_contract.note: The `--store` column of surface.verb-class-contract is checked against the four-valued `store` declaration by IM-245 in tests/test_cli_surface.py, not here -- one authority per rule. An exemption is a permanent licensed declaration that a flag's concept does not apply to a verb -- never a tracked gap, which belongs in `waivers` under an open owner. Each names the decision issue that vetted it in `decided_by` (required; `--check-issues` verifies that issue exists in the store, any status, because the field is provenance rather than ownership). Discipline decided on IM-292.

all-projects.meaning: Walk every project rather than the one resolved from cwd.

body-append.meaning: Append text to the anchored section.

body-append-file.meaning: Append body text read from a file or stdin.

body-prepend.meaning: Prepend text to the anchored section.

body-prepend-file.meaning: Prepend body text read from a file or stdin.

body-replace-file.meaning: Replace body text from a file or stdin.

body-seed-file.meaning: Use a file or stdin verbatim as the new issue body.

body-suppress.meaning: Omit the body from the rendering.

claim-generation.meaning: The fencing counter the caller read, guarding against a reap-and-reclaim cycle.

claimant.meaning: The actor identity a TTL lease is held by.

closing-note.meaning: The note recorded on the transition -- a completion summary or a reason, depending on the state being entered.

commit-message.meaning: Override the commit message for this mutation.

commit-timeout.meaning: Acquisition timeout in seconds for the store-wide commit lock. A distinct concept from the per-issue lock bound: IM-242 decided the name follows the lock.

deviations.note: The edit surface composes several dep ops in one invocation under a single lock, so its operands are argv-ordered and repeatable; `dep` authors one edge per call.

dep-kind.meaning: The kind of dependency edge being authored.

deviations.note: Same composition licence as the dependency kind.

dep-note.meaning: A note recorded on the dependency edge.

dry-run.meaning: Report what the invocation would do and make no change.

etag-guard.meaning: The git SHA the caller read from, so a drifted section refuses rather than being overwritten.

filtered-explanation.meaning: Whether to render the explanatory non-ready candidate section.

frontmatter-set.meaning: Set a frontmatter field, as FIELD=VALUE.

help-output.meaning: Print the verb's usage and flag reference, then exit 0.

history-revision.meaning: The commit, tag, branch, or date to read at.

issue-type.meaning: Restrict the result to these issue types.

deviations.note: The read verbs enumerated by the licensing requirement take an optional gh-style field list; everywhere else --json is valueless. This is the documented per-class capability the clause names, and the only value-space split on the surface that has one.

json-output.meaning: Emit the verb's result as one machine-readable JSON document on stdout, with informational notices on stderr.

lease-release.meaning: Clear the claim, preserving the fencing counter.

lease-ttl.meaning: Lease lifetime in seconds for this claim.

lock-timeout.meaning: Acquisition timeout in seconds for the per-issue advisory write lock.

non-interactive.meaning: Refuse to prompt; take every value from argv or fail.

note-date.meaning: Override the date stamped on the appended note.

position-after.meaning: Position the section after this one.

position-before.meaning: Position the section before this one.

position-index.meaning: Position the section at this 1-based index.

deviations.note: A project is registered under exactly one prefix, so the two verbs that WRITE a prefix take one scalar where the read verbs take a repeatable list. IM-236 settled that this is one concept, not two: the question each verb answers is which prefix to operate on, and whether it then reads or writes follows from the verb. Admissibility is not meaning -- a read verb refuses a prefix the store does not have, and `admin init-project` exists to create one -- exactly as an issue id must exist for `show` and must not for `create`.

prefix-scope.meaning: The project prefix(es) the invocation operates on -- the scope a read verb filters by, and the prefix a scaffolding verb registers a project under.

query-syntax.meaning: Which matcher interprets the free-text query.

reindex-suppression.meaning: Skip the automatic INDEX.md regeneration this mutation would run.

remove-dep.meaning: Retract every dependency edge to a target.

repo-identity.meaning: The repo basename used for the <store>/.repos registry lookup.

result-limit.meaning: Cap the rows emitted; 0 means unlimited everywhere on the surface.

section-body.meaning: The body text for a section being added.

section-seed.meaning: Set a body section's content at creation time, as NAME=TEXT.

section-selector.meaning: Name an existing level-2 section to act on.

since-window.meaning: Restrict history to commits after this git-parseable revision date.

status-filter.meaning: Restrict the result to these workflow statuses.

store-root.meaning: The store root the invocation operates on -- the highest-precedence override in the resolution chain on verbs that resolve a store, and the destination on the scaffolding verb that creates or converges one; which follows from the verb (the IM-236 admissibility rule).

version-output.meaning: Print the installed issue-mgmt version, then exit 0.

whole-body-replace.meaning: Replace the entire body below the frontmatter fence.

working-branch.meaning: The working branch recorded on the issue.

positionals.meaning: A legacy .issues/ directory to reindex -- a distinct concept from a store root; passing both this and --store is an argument error.
